description: Read: free memory, platform and the whole job queue with positions and estimated times. Call first.
name: system_status

description: Read: best models not installed yet that fit this machine. You cannot download them; tell the user which to get.
name: recommend_models

description: Read: installed models of a kind with id, size, fit, limits and frame rules.
name: list_models

description: Read: ready text-to-speech voices with language.
name: list_voices

description: Make: start an image job (returns a job id) for a picture on its own (poster, cover). Not for film stills: storyboard_generate makes those. Sizes snap to what the model supports.

image_strength.description: Single start image only: higher stays closer to it (mflux default 0.4).

include_preview.description: Also return the PNG as base64.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Default: best installed fit.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

reference_images.description: Paths or upload: handles. Only for models with acceptsImageInput (list_models); some take one, FLUX 3 Klein up to four.

name: generate_image

description: Make: start a video job (returns a job id). Give seconds; frames follow the model's rule. Takes minutes.

end_image.description: Path or upload: handle of the last frame. May be used alone. Only for models with acceptsEndImage (list_models).

image_strength.description: 1.0 follows the image closely (default); lower lets the clip drift.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Default: best installed fit.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

start_image.description: Path or upload: handle of the first frame. Only for models with acceptsImageInput (list_models).

name: generate_video

description: Make: start a text-to-speech job (returns a job id). Cancellable while running.

guidance.description: Chatterbox: how closely a voice sample is followed; default 0.5.

language.description: Language code (en, de, ja ...) or auto. Chatterbox voices speak the chosen language.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

style.description: Style instruction for preset voices on the 1.7B model, or the voice description for the design voice.

name: speak

description: Send: a small image, sound or video (about 8 MB) as base64. Returns an upload: handle to use in place of a path; lasts 24 hours. Larger files: POST the bytes to /api/agent/uploads.
name: upload_file

description: Make: start a speech-to-text job for a file on the machine running the app. Cancellable while running.
name: transcribe

description: Read: state, progress, queue position, notes and output of a job.

job_id.description: Job id from a tool that starts a job, or list_jobs.

name: job_status

description: Read: like job_status, but waits up to timeout_seconds (max 60). Call again if not finished.

job_id.description: Job id from a tool that starts a job, or list_jobs.

name: wait_for_job

description: Read: recent jobs (newest first), kept 7 days and across restarts. Use to find a lost job id.
name: list_jobs

description: Stop: cancel a queued or running job (image, video, music, speech, transcript, storyboard).

job_id.description: Job id from a tool that starts a job, or list_jobs.

name: cancel_job

description: Edit: film projects. create(name, size or aspect+resolution, fps, image_model, video_model, voice), list, get, edit(same, or fields), undo, redo, delete, export, import, add_ref/edit_ref/remove_ref (cast), plan, brand.

add_image.description: edit_ref: one more picture (4 at most).

brief.description: plan: the idea of the film.

caption.description: brand: caption look {font (installed family, "" for default), colour #RRGGBB, position bottom|middle|top}; also the card typeface and colour.

description.description: add_ref, edit_ref: what it looks like.

fields.description: edit: fields as in the project JSON. defaults{width, height, fps, imageModel, finalImageModel, videoModel, voice, exportPreset, resolution}; export{captionsBurn (draw captions into the picture), captionsSrt, stems, upscale, loudnessLufs}.

file.description: Bundle file name an export returned, with its project_id (import).

image_model.description: create, edit: image model id for stills (list_models image). Unset: the fastest installed.

images.description: add_ref: up to 4 pictures (upload: handles, output files, or a take's media/ still). Make one hero picture first with generate_image and pass its output path. Shots then list the ref id in fields.referenceImages and leave seed unset.

kind.description: add_ref. character, place: keeps a face or place the same across shots. style: the look of the whole film (pictures, words, palette read from them).

logo.description: brand: logo picture (upload: handle or output file); "" removes.

name.description: create: the project's name. add_ref (required), edit_ref: the cast entry's name.

palette.description: edit_ref on a style: its colours, trimmed.

path.description: Path of a .chaosfilm file in a storyboard exports folder (import).

ref_id.description: edit_ref, remove_ref. Shots use it in fields.referenceImages.

remove_image.description: edit_ref: position of a picture to drop.

resolution.description: Size from the aspect: 720p (default) at 16:9 is 1280x720. size overrides it.

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

size.description: create, edit: exact film size WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1024x576 (even, 64 to 4096; sets the aspect too). Multiples of 64 need no resize for LTX clips.

style_use.description: brand: how shots take the style.

upscale.description: Export upscale; none keeps the project size.

video_model.description: create, edit: video model id for clips (list_models video). Unset: the best installed fit.

voice.description: create, edit: the project's default narration voice id (list_voices).

name: storyboard_project

description: Edit: shots. add(fields), edit(shot_id, fields), remove, reorder(order), lock, unlock, pick_take(take_id), redo (mark for next run), import(clip or still), end_image(LTX-2), vocal(WAV/FLAC to lip-sync); path or none.

fields.description: title, stillPrompt, motionPrompt, startFrom (generate|upload|previous-shot|text), seconds, seed (leave unset on shots with referenceImages: the reference's seed returns a copy of it), trimIn, trimOut, speed, transition{type,seconds}, nativeSoundDb, index, vocalStart, vocalSinging, vocalTakes.

path.description: upload: handle, or a file in the app's output folders (import, end_image, vocal).

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

name: storyboard_shot

description: Edit: audio lanes. add(kind, path or library_id, fields), edit(clip_id, fields), remove(clip_id). A made sound plays only once added. Anchor to a shot with fields.anchor {shotId, offset}.

fields.description: anchor{shotId,offset} or start, trimIn, trimOut, gainDb (leave it unset on a voice: the app measures the file and sets 0 to +12 dB so it sits over the music; a value you give wins, 0 too), fadeIn, fadeOut, duck (music ducks under voice unless duck=false), loop, label.

library_id.description: add: a Music library track id (make_music tracks[].id) instead of path.

path.description: add: the output path speak, make_music (tracks[0].path) or make_sound returned, an upload: handle, or a file in the app's output folders.

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

name: storyboard_audio

description: Make: new takes: all stills, then all clips. Default: shots that need work, skipping locked. Returns a job id for wait_for_job.

draft.description: Make drafts: the fast image model at a smaller size.

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

what.description: final: redo only the shots marked Keep for final, with the quality image model. redo-clip: new clip from the current still; redo-still: new still, old clip kept until remade.

name: storyboard_generate

description: Make: a generate batch. status, pause (stops after the step in progress; a restart also pauses), resume(revision; a job id like generate), cancel.

batch_id.description: From generate's output or the project's batches.

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

name: storyboard_batch

description: Edit: the song a music video is cut to. attach(library_id or path), get, edit(lyrics, sections, bpm, title), remove, cut_plan(seconds; shots on beats; apply replaces shots), lyric_captions(timing), vocals(path: vocal stem; lip-sync slice per shot).

apply.description: cut_plan: replace the shots with the plan (one undo).

library_id.description: attach: a Music library track id.

path.description: attach, vocals: upload: handle or a file in the app's output folders. vocals without path slices the song itself (a stem follows better).

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

seconds.description: cut_plan: the film's length (a 30 s ad: 30); only the song's first seconds are cut.

name: storyboard_song

description: Make: render the film to MP4 (preview by default). Returns a job id and warnings; the output has the file, download, warnings and extras (captions, stems). A failed render resumes when called again.

notify.description: Show a system banner on this computer when it ends.

preview.description: true (default) makes a small fast draft, not the finished film; pass preview: false for the final MP4.

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

name: storyboard_render

description: Edit: captions. generate(clip_ids, language; transcribes voice clips, a job), export_srt (download), set(clip_id, cues), add(start, end, text), edit(caption_id), remove(caption_id).

clip_id.description: set, add: the audio clip the captions belong to (none: the timeline's own).

revision.description: Project revision you last saw (from get).

name: storyboard_captions

description: Make: write the cut as an OpenTimelineIO file for Resolve or Premiere. Returns the file, download and warnings.
name: storyboard_export_otio

description: Make: start a music job (returns a job id): a song with lyrics, or instrumental=true. 10 to 600 s, FLAC into the Music Library. Cancellable while running.

lyrics.description: Lyrics with [verse] / [chorus] tags. Needed unless instrumental.

model.description: Model id from list_models kind music. Default: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

variations.description: 1, 2 or 4 takes with seeds seed, seed+1, ...

name: make_music

description: Read: cloned voices the person made in the app with a stored permission record, with ids. Refused unless they allowed agents to use cloned voices.
name: list_cloned_voices

description: Make: start a speech job in a cloned voice (returns a job id). voice_id comes from list_cloned_voices and is tied to its permission record. permission_confirmed must be true. Output is tagged and watermarked as AI-made.

permission_confirmed.description: true: this is the person's own voice, or the speaker's permission covers this use. Recorded in the audit log.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

name: speak_cloned

description: Make: start a sound-effect job (returns a job id): footsteps, doors, ambience, a loop. 1 to 11 s by default, longer with the 1.0 or Stable Audio 3 models (modelId). English prompt, FLAC in the Music Library. Not songs with vocals or speech.

caption.description: The sound: 'heavy wooden door creaking open, close mic'.

loop.description: Make the clip a seamless loop (ambience, beats).

modelId.description: Sound model: 'stabilityai/stable-audio-open-small' (default, up to 11 s), 'stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0' (up to 47 s, slower), or on an NVIDIA GPU 'stabilityai/stable-audio-3-small-sfx' (up to 120 s), '-small-music' (instrumentals, 120 s) or '-medium' (380 s).

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

seconds.description: Length; the chosen model's own maximum applies (11 s Small, 47 s 1.0, 120 s or 380 s Stable Audio 3).

steps.description: Diffusion steps. Fewer is faster but can sound worse. Default: 8 Small (range 1 to 32), 100 for 1.0 (range 10 to 150).

variations.description: 1, 2 or 4 takes with seeds seed, seed+1, ...

name: make_sound

description: Make: start a lip-sync video job (returns a job id): a start still and a vocal clip become a 3 to 8 s clip whose mouth follows the audio. Needs an LTX-2.3 model with lipSync in list_models. Singing: use the vocal stem and set singing.

audio.description: upload: handle, or a file in the app's output folders: the vocal clip (WAV or FLAC; mono is fine). A vocal stem follows best; the full mix works less well.

audio_start.description: Where in the audio the shot starts, in seconds (default 0).

model.description: Model id from list_models with lipSync. Default: the installed one.

project_id.description: Optional. Storyboard project this output belongs to; the gallery and library group it there.

project_name.description: Optional label for project_id when the project is not in the Storyboard.

prompt.description: The shot: who sings or speaks, framing, light. Keep the camera still.

seconds.description: Shot length; default: the audio from audio_start, held to 3 to 8 s. Frames follow 8k+1 at 24 fps.

singing.description: The vocal is sung: adds singing wording to the prompt (stops takes that listen with a shut mouth). Also: use a vocal stem, start 0.4 s before a phrase, keep 3 to 5 s, a frontal still. Leave off for speech.

start_image.description: Path or upload: handle of the still the clip starts from (a face, frontal works best).

takes.description: Takes, each with its own seed; the sync score keeps the best. Default 3 when singing, else 1; 4 for best quality.

name: make_lipsync_shot

description: Edit: the Music Library. list(query, tag, limit, offset), get(track_id; adds a download link), rename(track_id, title and/or tags), delete(track_id; permanent).

query.description: list: matches title, caption and tags.

name: music_library
